title: Elevated errors for multiple models
excerpt: Claude's Status Page - Elevated errors for multiple models.
content_html:
Resolved

This issue has been resolved. From 9:50pm PT / 04:50 UTC through 00:36am PT / 07:36 UTC, users saw elevated errors on requests to Claude models, including Claude Opus 5 and Fable 5.

Posted Aug 24, 2026 - 08:30 UTC

Update

At this time, we have seen errors stabilize on Opus 5 and Fable 5, and are working to fully resolve success rates on all affected models. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

Posted Aug 24, 2026 - 07:47 UTC

Update

We are continuing to work to resolve issues causing elevated requests on multiple models. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

Posted Aug 24, 2026 - 06:42 UTC

Identified

We have identified the cause of elevated errors on requests to Claude Mythos 5, Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5, and other Claude models and are working on a fix. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

Posted Aug 24, 2026 - 05:27 UTC

Investigating

We are investigating elevated errors on requests to Claude Mythos 5, Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Opus 4.8. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

Posted Aug 24, 2026 - 05:06 UTC

This incident affected: claude.ai, Claude API (api.anthropic.com), Claude Code, and Claude Cowork.
